scope: Final D8 calibration frozen before decision seeds. Pool is selected by resources and the predetermined working-set ranking; baseline by pooled hinted recomputation on calibration only. Treatment benefit has not been used. Seven calibration one-shot timeouts remain: one in each arm of seed12003, with3.346789909 seconds available before the common cutoff. Store-allocation refusals remain separate evidence from failed stores/transfers; their paired deltas require attribution.
